newsitem.title: ITALY: Milan bourse BCI index closed at record 922.68.
newsitem.headline: Milan bourse BCI index closed at record 922.68.

text.p: The closely-watched BCI index, tracking all listed stocks on the Milan bourse, closed on Thursday at an all-time high of 922.68.
The index, widely known as the Comit index, is calculated once daily after the close of trade. The index was introduced in 1972.
The previous record of 908.20 was reached on May 20 1986.
The index closed on Wednesday at 896.68. Milan newsroom +392-66102321
